title: Continuity of Care for New Members — Utilization Management Program Coverage Terms
content:
## Terms

A new member who had an approval for a drug at their prior pharmacy carrier keeps coverage for it under the Utilization Management Program without a new review for the package's continuity approval days from the review program effective date, provided the prior carrier's approval letter is on file and, when the package requires prior-carrier claims, prior-carrier claims history for the drug is on file too.

A continuity-of-care approval may be granted only within the package's continuity-of-care days (calendar days) of the review program effective date, counting that date as day 1.

The member must obtain a regular approval before the continuity approval ends.

## The grant window

- **Clock starts:** the effective date of the member's review program, as the system records show it — counted as day 1.
- **Comparison:** the date of the grant must be no later than the last day of the window; the last day itself is inside the window.
- **Evidence:** the review program record of the member, not the member's recollection of when coverage began.

| Package window | Review program effective (day 1) | Last day a grant is allowed | First day it is not |
|---|---|---|---|
| 90 days | 1 March | 29 May (day 90) | 30 May (day 91) |
| 60 days | 1 March | 29 April (day 60) | 30 April (day 61) |

*Hypothetical dates.*

## What must be on file

| Package requires prior-carrier claims | Prior carrier's approval letter on file | Prior-carrier claims history for the drug on file | Coverage kept without a new review |
|---|---|---|---|
| No | Yes | either | Yes |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | Yes | No | No |
| either | No | either | No |
